name: ByteGuard AST
tagline: Static analysis & automated vulnerability auditor for student git repositories.
description: Inspects AST syntax trees, detects hardcoded secrets, flags unsafe memory buffers, and prevents vulnerable dependency imports before git commits leave your machine. Built by C2C for hackathon submissions.

name: NeuralByte DSA Battleground
tagline: 1v1 algorithmic speedruns with real-time AST cheat detection and bytecode telemetry.
description: Built for C2C's bi-weekly DSA clashes. Matches Chitkara coders in head-to-head LeetCode-style duels with isolated Docker test runners, memory profilers, and live visual execution trees.

name: Chitkara P2P CampusMesh
tagline: Decentralized local-network compute pool and artifact sharing for hostel labs.
description: Hostel Wi-Fi chokes on heavy PyTorch weights and Docker base layers. CampusMesh seeds heavy binaries across dorm subnets over Libp2p with zero internet egress costs and sub-millisecond local latency.

name: PromptForge Edge Runner
tagline: Local-first evals & synthetic dataset synthesis for small language models.
description: Student devs don't have $10k GPU clusters. PromptForge runs quantized GGUF models on Apple Silicon and RTX laptops, scoring prompt robustness against 100+ automated adversarial test harnesses.
